value.rationale: The all-parameter square-zero census answers a natural nilpotent-stratum question for generalized matrix/Munn algebras, complementing the known idempotent census for exactly the same algebraic family. Intermediate sandwich rank creates nontrivial simultaneous square-zero and annihilation constraints absent in classical M_r square-zero counting. The rank-one case has two explicit reduced affine components with dimensions and intersection, demonstrating structural information beyond a bare finite table. General nilpotency indices remain open.
